mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome—I'm really glad you're here. Have you ever noticed how sometimes the hardest moments in life can spark the wildest laughter? Together, we’re about to step into a story that’s honest, hilarious, and unexpectedly hopeful. There’s this book by Jenny Lawson called Furiously Happy: A Funny Book About Horrible Things, and it invites us into a world where mental illness doesn’t just lurk in the shadows—it dances in the spotlight, wrapped in stories that are equal parts absurd and deeply moving. Jenny opens up about living with depression, anxiety, and all those messy, complicated feelings that so many of us know too well. But instead of hiding, she faces them head-on—with wit, vulnerability, and a parade of unforgettable moments featuring everything from taxidermied raccoons to the awkward beauty of being unapologetically human. As we explore her confessions and wild adventures, you'll feel how pain and joy can blend together, and maybe even discover that embracing every part of who we are—flaws and all—isn’t just brave, it’s necessary. What if choosing to be “furiously happy” is actually a rebellious, hopeful act? So, let’s dive in together. Get ready to laugh, reflect, and find light in places you’d never expect.
